params.text: Single person in soft-soled sneakers walking at a fast run on thick, waterlogged commercial office carpet, close microphone, completely dry room with no echo, no other sounds, no voices, no music. Each footstep is a muffled low thud followed by a wet squelch as water is pressed out of the sodden carpet, and a small squish as the foot lifts. No hard heel click. Clean separate footsteps with silence between them. Varied gait.
